summary: Suozzi has positioned himself as a steadfast Israel defender, stating in 2026 that he "unequivocally support[s] the State of Israel" and "won't bend on Israel" as colleagues shift positions. His official House site described him as "speaking up for Israel." He also voted Yea in 2024 on H.R. 6090, which directs use of the IHRA definition in Title VI education-discrimination enforcement.
